Hi Team Roof top cafe,

I noticed your cafe has strong 4.1★ reviews on Gola Road in Patna, but currently lacks a dedicated mobile website for direct table reservations and rooftop dining bookings.

Maine aapke rooftop cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, rooftop menu, aur evening ambiance gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://roof-top-cafe-demo.arclane.workers.dev

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Roof top cafe team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with a direct WhatsApp table booking feature and rooftop menu showcase for your location on Gola Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
